findings.evidence: _NUMBER only groups commas as \d{1,3}(,\d{3})+, ignores spaces as group separators and drops any sign. numbers('Rs 5,00,000')={'5','00000'} and numbers('Rs 5,00,00,000')={'5','00','00000'}, a superset, so verify('The state subsidy for each rural household is Rs 5,00,000 under the new housing scheme [1].', ['...is Rs 5,00,00,000 under the new housing scheme.']) -> KEPT (5 lakh vs 5 crore), and evaluate() on the two sentences -> conflicts 0 (subset rule at evaluate.py:162). Same with ₹. '1 000 000 euros' vs source '1 500 000 euros' -> KEPT, 0 conflicts. '-3.2%' vs '3.2%', '−3.2%' vs '3.2%' and '-12 degrees' vs '12 degrees' -> KEPT, 0 conflicts. Probes: /tmp/uri_review_R5/p_num.py, p_num2.py. W1-AC10 requires dropping sentences whose numbers do not occur in the cited source; W1-AC11 requires flagging different numbers. The module targets Rs/lakh/crore usage (R4-02 repair), where lakh grouping is the normal written form.
findings.suggested_fix: Tokenise whole numerals first: accept Indian grouping (\d{1,2}(,\d{2})*,\d{3}) and space/thin-space/NBSP grouping (\d{1,3}([ \u00a0\u2009\u202f]\d{3})+), strip the separators to one canonical integer, and keep a leading '-'/'−' (or 'minus') as part of the value. Add regressions for 5,00,000 vs 5,00,00,000, 1 000 000 vs 1 500 000 and -3.2% vs 3.2% in verify and find_conflicts.
findings.title: Citation verifier and conflict detector mis-parse Indian lakh/crore digit grouping, space-grouped thousands and minus signs, so a claim with a different amount survives verify (R1-01/R4-02 class not closed)

findings.evidence: The api_key rule needs '(sk|pk|rk)-' with a hyphen, and long_secret cannot match across '_'. redact_text leaves sk_live_4eC39HqLyjWDarjtT1zdp7dc, rk_live_..., github_pat_11ABC..._..., glpat-..., npm_..., hf_..., SG.x.y unchanged. field_is_sensitive is False for name 'authorization' (value 'Basic dXNlcjpwYXNzd29yZA=='), 'smsTan'/'mTAN'/'tan' (value '482913'), 'otc', '2sv' and 'twoStep'. Real Chromium (snapshot.js on /tmp/uri_review_R5/fx/p.html) returns the sk_live_ and github_pat_ text and the authorization/smsTan values with sensitive:false. AssistCommands assist_ask with FakeAdapter puts 'dXNlcjpwYXNzd29yZA==', '482913' and 'sk_live_4eC39HqLyjWDarjtT1zdp7dc' in the Brain request body (p_brain.py). Non-blocking only because L-A0-2 documents that free-text secrets and fields without a secret signal may pass and AC7 is declared PATTERN-BASED, not MET. The redact.py docstring still claims 'common API-key prefixes' are masked.
findings.suggested_fix: Extend the api_key rule in both layers to (sk|rk|pk)_(live|test)_[A-Za-z0-9]{16,}, github_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]{40,}, glpat-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}, npm_[A-Za-z0-9]{36}, hf_[A-Za-z0-9]{30,} and SG\.[\w-]{16,}\.[\w-]{16,}. Add 'authoriz' and a whole-word 'tan'/'mtan'/'smstan' to the stems and a 'Basic <base64>' rule. Add these cases to the parity corpus.
findings.title: Redaction misses common API-key formats (Stripe sk_live_/rk_live_, GitHub github_pat_, GitLab glpat-, npm_, hf_, SendGrid SG.) and Authorization/TAN fields in both layers; values reach the Brain request (documented residual risk L-A0-2)

findings.evidence: grant -> assist_ask (COMPLETE) -> assist_revoke -> assist_ask_status(ask_id) returns state FINISHED with the answer text 'Your balance is 52,300.' and the observation summary (p_revoke.py). _answers is never cleared. The controller comment says 'everything derived is discarded'.
findings.suggested_fix: Clear _answers in _assist_revoke, _assist_grant and on expiry, or refuse assist_ask_status when the answer's grant is no longer current.
findings.title: Derived answers remain retrievable after Stop (R1-05 not repaired)

findings.evidence: With a resolver that takes 8 s, total_timeout=1.0 and cancel set at 0.3 s, fetch() returned after 8.03 s with TIMED_OUT, not CANCELLED (p_dns.py). The watchdog only runs inside _one(). With the system resolver the overrun is bounded by the stub resolver timeout (~5-10 s). L-W1-4 documents only a read-timeout overrun.
findings.suggested_fix: Run the resolver on a worker thread joined with the remaining budget and a cancel poll, or document the DNS overrun in L-W1-4.
findings.title: DNS resolution is outside the SafeFetcher total deadline and cancel check
